environment.transport: real HTTP over public internet -> AWS ALB -> ECS Fargate (us-east-2)
environment.note: client is a home Mac over public internet; latency INCLUDES ISP round-trip to us-east-2, so it is dominated by network RTT, not server compute. Rate limiter (100/min) left ENABLED — requests paced to stay under it; 429s excluded and counted as errors.
